name: C2 Blockchain, Inc.
summary: C2 Blockchain, Inc. operates as development-stage blockchain infrastructure company. The company engages in cryptocurrency mining, digital asset treasury management, and related technology activities. C2 Blockchain, Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Miami, Florida. As of February 18, 2025, C2 Blockchain, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Mendel Holdings, LLC.
